title: A unified high-resolution ODE framework for first-order methods
summary: For a generic discrete-time algorithm (DTA): $z^+=g(z,s)$, where $s$ is the step size, Lu (Math. Program., 194(1):1061--1112, 2022) proposed an $O(s^r)$-resolution ordinary differential equation (ODE) framework based on the backward error analysis, which can be used to analyze many DTAs satisfying the fixed point assumption $g(z,0)=z$ such as gradient descent, extra gradient method and primal-dual hybrid gradient (PDHG). However, most first-order methods with momentum violate this critical assumption. To address this issue, in this work, we introduce a novel $O((\sqrt{s})^r)$-resolution ODE…
